import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextInt()) {
            int n = sc.nextInt();
            int[] v = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                v[i] = sc.nextInt();
            }

            // Insertion sort
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                int key = v[i];
                int j = i - 1;
                while (j >= 0 && v[j] > key) {
                    v[j + 1] = v[j];
                    j--;
                }
                v[j + 1] = key;
            }

            System.out.println(v[n / 2]);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
